name: Zepto
description: Zepto is a brand/product of Kiranakart Technologies Pvt Ltd. Pre-IPO as of FY25 (DRHP filed; not yet listed) — remains privately held for now.

stock.note: Privately held — pre-IPO as of FY25 (DRHP filed for a planned listing; not yet trading).

source.name: Analytics Insight — Zepto FY25 sales surge 129% to Rs 9,669 crore

marketing_spend.derivation: Disclosed: Zepto's advertising and promotional expense rose from ₹303.5 crore in FY24 to ₹1,186.6 crore in FY25 (~10.7-12% of revenue), as the quick-commerce player scaled aggressively pre-IPO. Note: some press reports cite a higher FY25 'total revenue' figure of ₹11,110 crore alongside this — the ₹9,668.8 crore figure used here is consistently reported as 'total sales'/revenue from operations across multiple sources; the ₹11,110 crore figure could not be confirmed as the audited revenue-from-operations line and was excluded.

source.name: Univest — Zepto IPO DRHP: user base dips, marketing costs surge FY26

business_updates.headline: Zepto FY25 sales surge 129% to ₹9,669 crore while net loss widens; advertising expense rises to ₹1,186.6 crore
